name: cargo_class
description: The class of goods of each trade record's cargo.

questions.name: cargo_class
questions.instructions: Which class of goods makes up most of the cargo?

choices.foodstuffs: Grain, fish, meat, dairy, fruit and other food.
choices.colonial_goods: Sugar, spices, tobacco, coffee, tea and dyestuffs.
choices.textiles_and_fibres: Cloth, yarn, wool, flax, hemp and cotton.
choices.metals_and_minerals: Iron, copper, lead, coal, salt and stone.
choices.manufactured_goods: Tools, wares and other finished goods.
choices.mixed_or_unspecified: Several classes, ballast, or no stated goods.
